name: Fine Print
why_visit: Charters that expire mid-job. The ambush school sits where the paper runs out.

bodies.name: Expired Charter
bodies.blurb: The expired charter world. The stamp is a hole.
bodies.legal: A charter that already expired. Wreck rights. The school shoots the slow reader.
bodies.air: None. The office vented when the paper died.
bodies.face: Burned clause and open wreck rights.
bodies.ruins: The clause that ended at mid-burn.

bodies.name: Ambush School
bodies.blurb: Where the pack learns to wait.
bodies.legal: The school moon. Students hold the buoy and close when a keel enters the sight.
bodies.ruins: A student's first wreck, left as the lesson.

belt.name: Clause Rubble
belt.composition: burned charter foil and school plate from expired jobs
belt.legal: Expired foil. Red law. The rubble is wreck rights.

trash.name: Mid Job
trash.origin: Haulers cut off when the charter expired before the tow was reeled in.
trash.legal: Mid-job wrecks. The school keeps them as targets.

pocket.name: Clause Pocket
pocket.why: The clause is dead. A core would be the next lesson.

Kite over Fine Print. Keep the flank at 340 to 460 meters and punish a straight run.
Raider over Fine Print. Take the clerk's hull first. The captain is the second prize.

haulers.name: Expired Clerk
haulers.duty: Expired Clerk at Fine Print. The paper died mid-job. Run when the pack closes inside 640 meters.
